items.title: Sudhalter interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2019
items.q: I wanted to be a science writer on the popular level, like Rachel Carson

ctx.x: Well I had a question I was going to save until the end but I’m going to ask you now. This career in music, why did you do it?

Oh it’s a great question, okay. And I’m glad you didn’t save it for the end because it takes some times to answer. I was a biologist. I was a biology major and I loved, since I was a kid I was an insect collector, I didn’t play with dolls. I collected insects and I watched birds and that’s what I liked to do. And people gave me nature books for my birthdays and stuff. And so I got to college and I was a biology major and I wanted to be a science writer on the popular level, like Rachel Carson, to show alternative…

So I thought well I’d play a flute. So I asked around and someone in my dormitory had a flute that she wasn’t using and loaned it to me and I began to immediately try to start playing along with my records and I ran downtown and tried to sit in with the local band even though I still didn’t know where G sharp was and so forth. And so from there, you know, it got worse and worse. And I didn’t know at the beginning that I wanted to make it a career, I just knew that I was spending a lot of time sort of skipping…
